verdicts.title: Classifying Entanglement by Algebraic Geometry
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Quantum Entanglement is one of the key manifestations of quantum mechanics that separate the quantum realm from the classical one. Characterization of entanglement as a physical resource for quantum technology became of uppermost importance. verdicts.title: Fine-Structure Classification of Multiqubit Entanglement by Algebraic Geometry
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We present a fine-structure entanglement classification under stochastic local operation and classical communication (SLOCC) for multiqubit pure states. verdicts.title: Entangled Subspaces through Algebraic Geometry
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We propose an algebraic geometry-inspired approach for constructing entangled subspaces within the Hilbert space of a multipartite quantum system. Specifically, our method employs a modified Veronese embedding, restricted to the conic, to define subspaces within the symmetric part of the Hilbert space.
